# 038-car

**Provider.** Rentalcars.com, car hire voucher in English for a rental supplied by Avis.

**Format.** Standalone single-page A4 PDF. Three reference boxes across the top (Rentalcars.com booking reference, Avis confirmation number, status), then the main driver, pick-up and drop-off side by side, the car, an itemised price table, cancellation terms and a counter checklist.

**Why.** An OTA voucher with two references, where the supplier's confirmation number is the `booking_ref` and the Rentalcars.com one goes in `notes`. A one-way rental from an airport to a railway station in another city, so start and end places differ and only the pick-up has an airport code. The arriving flight number and its time must not be taken as the pick-up, the €1,100 deposit is not the price, and the total paid includes a separately sold protection product.
